_source: lgu/assets/reference docs/ — the Sept 2026 batch of office submissions. Per-file audit: that folder's README.md. Checklist mapping: 'Calatrava LGU Website Development.xlsx' -> Checklist tab, columns H (Reference Document(s)) and I (Coverage / Gaps).
_status: STRUCTURE ONLY — NO CONTENT PARSED YET. Every content field below is deliberately empty.
_note: Target shape for the per-office profiles in the Sept 2026 batch. The raw submissions are .gitignore'd (~30 MB of scans and DOCX) and live only on RJ's machine, so the parse has to run where those files are. Fill each field by typing it from the source document itself -- NOT from the audit README's summary and NOT from memory: the README is a second-hand index written to catalogue the batch, not a transcript. Five of the documents are scans with no text layer (MSWDO, MBO, MEO LBP4, LDRRMF, Supplemental Budgets), so their figures must be double-checked against the scan. Keep every figure, name and peso amount verbatim. Leave a field empty rather than filling it from a plausible guess -- the renderer degrades honestly and an empty field is a visible gap, which is the house rule for this site.

_statusValues.pending-parse: A source document is on hand; its content has not been typed into this file yet.
_statusValues.covered-elsewhere: The office's submission duplicated content already parsed into another data file.
_statusValues.awaiting-submission: The office sent nothing in this batch. Listed so the gap is visible and chaseable.
_statusValues.fdp-only: Submission is a Full Disclosure document, not office-profile content; belongs in transparency.json.
_statusValues.parsed: Content typed in and checked against the source. Nothing has reached this state yet.

_schema.acronym: Short label as used elsewhere on this site (officials.json departments). Empty string where the Citizen's Charter gives none -- do not invent one.
_schema.office: Canonical office name. Matches organization.json's 'office' where the office is in the 2026 org chart.
_schema.orgChartOffice: The organization.json office this profile belongs to, or null for a body that is not a plantilla office (BPLO, MNAO, HRMO, SB).
_schema.sourceDocs: File names inside 'lgu/assets/reference docs/', exactly as renamed there.
_schema.charterPages: Pages of Citizen's Charter 2023 covering this office's frontline services, where it has any. Cross-reference only -- the services themselves stay in citizens-charter.json.
_schema.mandate: Verbatim mandate statement. Plain string, or an array of strings where the source numbers them (MBO has 5, MEO has 4).
_schema.vision: Verbatim office-level vision. Distinct from the municipal vision in officials.json -- do not merge the two.
_schema.services: Array of { name, description, requirements[], fees, processingTime, charterRef }. Where a service is already in citizens-charter.json, set charterRef and leave fees/processingTime empty rather than copying a second figure that can drift.
_schema.staff: Array of { name, position, mobile }. Only where the office supplied it. These are office staff lists, distinct from organization.json's plantilla positions and from contact.json's office-head directory.
_schema.statistics: Array of { label, value, unit, asOf, source }. 'asOf' is the reference period the document states; 'source' names the document or the cited original (e.g. CLUP).
_schema.contact: Office-level phone/email/hours as the document gives them. Never publish a number that is not a valid PH length.
_schema.has: What the source document actually contains, from the audit. A checklist for the parse, not site content -- drop or ignore it once 'status' is 'parsed'.
_schema.gaps: What the office did not supply, plus any quality warning that must be resolved before publishing.

_render: Not rendered on any page yet, by design. The IA decision comes first: per-office detail pages linked from about.html#departments-section, or an expandable panel per office on that page. Whichever is chosen, office-level vision/mission must stay visually distinct from the municipal vision/mission on the homepage, and a service that is already in citizens-charter.json should link to services.html#charter rather than restate its fees. See MEMORY.md.
